playful_strings: Instrumental music for a 60-second trailer of a cheerful kids' video game of Bible stories, played as fast WarioWare-style microgames. Exactly 150 BPM, steady tempo, major key, joyful, warm and bouncy. No vocals. A short sparkling 3-second intro, an energetic groove, a brief quieter build around 20 to 30 seconds, a big happy chorus starting at 32 seconds, and a clean ending with one bright final hit at 60 seconds. Bouncy pizzicato strings, marimba, glockenspiel, ukulele, handclaps and light drums.
